error.provider_not_connected: There is no Connection for this Provider. Add one on the Models page.
error.not_supported: The Model Gateway does not support this request.
error.unknown_slot: The Harness asked for a Model Slot it does not declare.
error.slot_unbound: No model is bound to the Model Slot "{slot}". Choose one on the Models page.
error.provider_error: The Provider answered with an error: {detail}

manifest.schema_invalid_json: The Manifest is not valid JSON: {detail}
manifest.schema_invalid_json.not_seriali: The Manifest cannot be serialised as JSON: {detail}
manifest.schema_invalid_json.too_large: The Manifest is too large to check: it has more than {limit} values (objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans and nulls, not counting top-level "x-" keys and "$schema"). A valid Manifest has fewer than 200.
manifest.schema_invalid_json.too_many_pr: The Manifest has too many problems to check at once here. Remove the keys and list items the Manifest format does not define, then check it again.
manifest.schema_type.non_finite: The number is out of the range JSON numbers can hold (about ±1.8e308); found {actual}.
manifest.schema_type.entry_for_runtime_k: entry must be {expected} when runtime.kind is "{runtimeKind}"; found {actual}.
manifest.schema_enum.property_name: "{key}" is not allowed here. Allowed keys: {allowed}.
manifest.schema_pattern: Does not match the pattern {pattern}; found {actual}.
manifest.schema_pattern.harnessId: Must be a Harness ID "publisher/slug": publisher is the Publisher's GitHub login in lower case; slug is 3 to 40 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit. Found {actual}.
manifest.schema_pattern.license: Must be an SPDX license identifier such as "MIT" or "Apache-2.0", or "proprietary". Found {actual}.
manifest.schema_pattern.httpUrl: Must be an absolute http:// or https:// URL, without a user name or password before the host. Found {actual}.
manifest.schema_pattern.relativePath: Must be a path relative to the root of the Harness Package, with "/" separators and no leading "/", no "." or ".." segments, backslashes or colons. Found {actual}.
manifest.schema_pattern.nodeEntryPath: Must be the path of a .js, .mjs or .cjs file relative to the root of the Harness Package, with "/" separators and no leading "/", no "." or ".." segments, backslashes or colons. Found {actual}.
manifest.schema_pattern.uiPath: Must be a path on the Harness's local server that starts with a single "/", such as "/" or "/app", without spaces or backslashes. Found {actual}.
manifest.schema_pattern.slotName: Model Slot name "{key}" must start with a lower-case letter and contain only lower-case letters, digits and hyphens (at most 32 characters).
manifest.schema_pattern.modelId: Recommended Models must be "provider/model" ids such as "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5", with a lower-case Provider id. Found {actual}.
manifest.schema_pattern.domain: Must be a lower-case domain name such as "api.github.com", optionally starting with "*.". Found {actual}.
manifest.schema_pattern.unstorable_chara: The text contains {character}, which the Store cannot keep. Manifest text may not contain a NUL character (U+0000) or one half of a UTF-16 surrogate pair without the other (a JSON escape such as "\ud800" on its own). Remove it.
manifest.schema_required.network_access: Declare network access with "domains" (a list, which may be empty) or with "any": true.
manifest.schema_min_length: Must be at least {limit} characters long; found {actual}.
manifest.schema_max_length: Must be at most {limit} characters long; found {actual}.
manifest.schema_max_length.bytes: Must be at most {limit} bytes of UTF-8 text; found {actual}.
manifest.schema_min_items: Must list at least {limit} item(s); found {actual}.
manifest.schema_max_items: Must list at most {limit} items; found {actual}.
manifest.schema_max_properties: Must have at most {limit} entries; found {actual}.
manifest.schema_unique_items: {value} is listed more than once (first at index {firstIndex}).
manifest.unknown_key: Unknown key "{key}". Remove it, or rename it with an "x-" prefix to keep Publisher-private data in the Manifest.
manifest.slot_default_missing: The Manifest must declare a Model Slot named "default".
manifest.entry_missing_for_platform: entry has no path for platform "{platform}". A binary Harness needs an entry for every platform in platforms.
manifest.publisher_mismatch: The Harness ID belongs to publisher "{idPublisher}", but the Publisher is "{publisher}". The publisher segment must be your GitHub login in lower case.
manifest.version_invalid: "{version}" is not a strict semantic version. Use MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional pre-release (for example 1.2.0 or 1.2.0-beta.1) and no build metadata.
manifest.version_not_greater: Version {version} must be greater than every published version of this Harness; the latest is {latest}.
manifest.ignored_key.entry_platform: entry has a path for platform "{platform}", which is not listed in platforms; it is ignored.
manifest.ignored_key.ui_web_only: "{key}" applies to UI Kind "web" only; it is ignored for "{kind}".
manifest.ignored_key.runtime_node: "node" applies to runtime kind "node" only; it is ignored for "{kind}".
manifest.ignored_key.filesystem_paths: "paths" applies to filesystem scope "paths" only; it is ignored for scope "{scope}".
manifest.schema_invalid_json.file_too_la: manifest.json is larger than {limit} bytes (1 MB), far more than any Manifest needs, so it was not read.
manifest.entry_missing_for_platform.file: The Entry file "{file}" is not in the Harness Package, so the Runtime could not start the Harness.
manifest.entry_missing_for_platform.plat: The Entry file "{file}" for platform "{platform}" is not in the Harness Package, so the Runtime could not start the Harness there.
manifest.file_missing.manifest_nested: manifest.json must be at the root of the Harness Package, but it is at "{found}". Package the contents of the Harness folder, not the folder itself.
manifest.file_type.icon: The icon must be a PNG image; this file is not one, or its PNG header is damaged.
manifest.file_type.screenshot: Screenshots in assets/ must be PNG or JPEG images named .png, .jpg or .jpeg, with content to match.
manifest.file_type.special: The entry is neither a file nor a folder (it is a device, a named pipe or a socket). A Harness Package holds only files and folders.
manifest.icon_dimensions: The icon must be {expected}×{expected} pixels; found {width}×{height}.
manifest.archive_symlink: The entry is a symbolic link. A Harness Package may not contain links.
manifest.archive_path_traversal: The entry name has a ".." segment, so it would be unpacked outside the Harness Package.
manifest.archive_path_traversal.absolute: The entry name is an absolute path. Entries must be relative to the root of the Harness Package.
manifest.archive_path_traversal.other_na: The entry also carries the name {name} (in an Info-ZIP Unicode Path field), which is absolute or has a ".." segment, so some unpackers would place it outside the Harness Package.
manifest.archive_path_traversal.local_na: The entry's local header names it {name}, which is absolute or has a ".." segment, so unpackers that read the archive in order would place it outside the Harness Package.
manifest.archive_too_large: The Harness Package is {actual} bytes; the limit is {limit} bytes (500 MB), compressed.
manifest.archive_too_many_files: The Harness Package holds {actual} files; the limit is {limit}.
manifest.archive_too_many_files.not_coun: The Harness Package has more than {counted} entries, far more than the limit of {limit} files, so it was not checked further.
manifest.archive_invalid: The Harness Package is not a readable zip archive: {detail}.
manifest.archive_invalid.entry: The file cannot be read from the zip archive: {detail}.
manifest.archive_invalid.duplicate: The zip archive holds this path more than once.
manifest.archive_invalid.encrypted: The file is encrypted. Files in a Harness Package must not be.
manifest.archive_invalid.compression_met: The file uses compression method {method}; only stored (0) and Deflate (8) files can be unpacked.
manifest.archive_invalid.local_name: The entry's local header names it {name} instead. Unpackers that read the archive in order would use that name, so they would see other files than the ones checked.
manifest.archive_invalid.inconsistent: The zip entry is inconsistent: {detail}. Different unpackers could see different files here.
manifest.archive_invalid.unlisted_data: The zip archive holds {length} bytes at offset {offset} that belong to no entry of its central directory. Unpackers that read the archive in order could find files there that were never checked.
manifest.archive_invalid.name_character: The entry name contains {character}, which unpackers on Windows read differently from others ("\" as a folder separator, ":" as a file stream of another file). Use "/" between folders and no ":" in names.
manifest.archive_invalid.name_control: The entry name contains a control character (a byte between 0 and 31, or 127). Many unpackers cut the name off at it or refuse it, so they would unpack a different file than the one checked.
manifest.archive_invalid.case_conflict: The Harness Package also holds {other}, whose path differs from this one only in letter case, Unicode form or trailing dots and spaces. On macOS or Windows both are the same file, so one would overwrite the other.
manifest.archive_invalid.file_folder_con: The Harness Package also holds the folder {other}, with files in it, at the path of this file (ignoring letter case and Unicode form), so the two cannot both be unpacked.
manifest.file_too_large.readme: README.md is {actual} bytes; keep it to at most {limit} bytes (50 KB).
manifest.file_too_large.screenshot: The screenshot is {actual} bytes; keep each screenshot to at most {limit} bytes (2 MB).
manifest.screenshots_too_many: assets/ holds {actual} screenshots; keep it to at most {limit}.
